name: Acute Respiratory Infection
description: Inflammation of the respiratory tract caused by viruses or bacteria.

ayurvedicRemedies.title: Steam Inhalation
ayurvedicRemedies.description: Add a few drops of eucalyptus oil to hot water and inhale the steam for 5-10 minutes.

ayurvedicRemedies.title: Tulsi-Ginger Tea
ayurvedicRemedies.description: Boil 5-6 tulsi leaves, a small piece of ginger, and a pinch of black pepper in water. Drink twice daily.

whenToSeeDoctor: If breathing difficulty worsens or fever persists beyond 3 days.

name: Asthma
description: Chronic condition where airways narrow and swell, causing breathing difficulty.
precautions: Avoid outdoor activities during high AQI

ayurvedicRemedies.title: Turmeric Milk
ayurvedicRemedies.description: Mix 1 tsp turmeric in warm milk and drink before bed.

whenToSeeDoctor: If inhaler does not help or symptoms worsen.

name: Typhoid
description: Bacterial infection spread through contaminated food/water.

ayurvedicRemedies.title: Giloy Juice
ayurvedicRemedies.description: Drink 10-15 ml Giloy juice daily to boost immunity.

whenToSeeDoctor: If fever persists more than 3 days.
